vocabulary.meaning: 时期，一段时间；阶段；周期
一致的；始终如一的；连续的

examples.text: The person to whom I complained is the supervisor.
examples.translation: 我向其投诉的那个人就是主管。
examples.speechText: The person to whom I complained is the supervisor.

examples.text: Preventive measures（measure的复数形式） like washing your hands often can significantly lower your odds of getting sick.
examples.translation: 经常洗手等预防措施，能够显著降低生病的可能性。
examples.speechText: Preventive measures like washing your hands often can significantly lower your odds of getting sick.

examples.text: The boy listed several examples in support of his viewpoints.
examples.translation: 那个男孩列举了几个例子来支持自己的观点。
examples.speechText: The boy listed several examples in support of his viewpoints.

examples.text: Things like earning a master's degree don't make people happy over an extended period of time.
examples.translation: 获得硕士学位之类的事情，并不能让人长期保持快乐。
examples.speechText: Things like earning a master's degree don't make people happy over an extended period of time.

examples.text: It is important to be consistent with our exercise routine, whatever the weather.
examples.translation: 无论天气如何，坚持日常锻炼都很重要。
examples.speechText: It is important to be consistent with our exercise routine, whatever the weather.

examples.text: Throughout this century English has grown more and more important.
examples.translation: 在整个这个世纪里，英语变得越来越重要。
examples.speechText: Throughout this century English has grown more and more important.

examples.text: With prices（price的复数形式） fluctuating so much, it's hard for the company to plan a budget.
examples.translation: 价格波动如此之大，公司很难制定预算。
examples.speechText: With prices fluctuating so much, it's hard for the company to plan a budget.

examples.text: Being quiet can help you sleep well.
examples.translation: 保持安静有助于睡得好。
examples.source: （2017年配套材料·选句填空·完整句选项）
examples.speechText: Being quiet can help you sleep well.

examples.text: Baidu knows everything, but colleagues often give much better advice.
examples.translation: 百度似乎无所不知，但同事往往能给出好得多的建议。
examples.speechText: Baidu knows everything, but colleagues often give much better advice.

examples.text: Pinned to their drawing（draw的-ing形式） boards are blueprints for improved quake-resistant buildings.
examples.translation: 钉在绘图板上的是改进抗震建筑的蓝图。
examples.speechText: Pinned to their drawing boards are blueprints for improved quake-resistant buildings.

examples.text: They have already demanded and won the right to patent new life forms.
examples.translation: 他们已经提出要求，并获得了为新生命形式申请专利的权利。
examples.speechText: They have already demanded and won the right to patent new life forms.

examples.text: Many parts of the country also have youth hostels where young people can stay for only a few dollars a night.
examples.translation: 这个国家的许多地区也有青年旅舍，年轻人每晚只需花几美元就能入住。
examples.speechText: Many parts of the country also have youth hostels where young people can stay for only a few dollars a night.

examples.text: The Jews followed their example, but kept every seventh day for religious purposes（purpose的复数形式）.
examples.translation: 犹太人效仿了他们的做法，但仍然在第七天保留用于宗教目的。
examples.speechText: The Jews followed their example, but kept every seventh day for religious purposes.

examples.text: Showing gratitude can motivate you to continue your journey of self-improvement.
examples.translation: 表达感激能够激励你继续自我提升。
examples.speechText: Showing gratitude can motivate you to continue your journey of self-improvement.

examples.text: He was caught cheating in the examination.
examples.translation: 他考试作弊时被当场发现。
examples.speechText: He was caught cheating in the examination.
